name: perseverance
example: I kept going back to a hard climbing route until I finally did it.

name: calm under pressure
example: In a test, while everyone else panicked, I made a plan and went through it step by step.

name: logical thinking
example: I found a mistake in a task that nobody else in the group could see.

name: explaining to others
example: I explained a topic to a friend before a quiz and they passed.

name: empathy
example: I noticed someone was having a bad day and started a conversation.

name: accuracy
example: I check a text twice before I hand it in.

name: curiosity about the world
example: I read about something late into the night because I want to know how it works.

name: teamwork
example: In a group project I made sure everyone had their own task.

name: discipline and routine
example: I go to the gym regularly, even when I do not feel like it.

name: fitness
example: I train several times a week and I can see my progress.

name: languages
example: I get by in English without stress, and I can talk in Ukrainian.

name: learning fast
example: I figured out a new program in one evening.

name: organising
example: I planned a trip with friends: tickets, a place to stay, a plan for each day.

name: inventiveness
example: I thought of a different way to do a task and it worked.

name: responsibility for others
example: I looked after my younger brother when my parents went away.

name: drawing and spatial imagination
example: I drew a plan of my room to scale and moved the furniture so that a desk fitted in.

name: convincing others
example: I sold my old bike for a better price than I expected.

name: finding your way on a map and outdoors
example: I led my family along a mountain trail with a map and nobody got lost.

name: an eye for art and detail
example: On a trip I noticed that two churches have the same vaulted ceiling.
